title: ONE INBOUND LINE IN THE CALLED RING
why: Found by the overnight regression run. When the ring badges became short caps callouts, the one over the ring you are standing in started saying EXTRACTION A INBOUND with its seconds, while the band above the belt says the same thing. That is the double line v22.41 took away. While you stand in the ring you called, only the band shows it now. From outside the ring, or for a ring somebody else called, the badge is drawn as before.
now: Standing in the ring you called, the INBOUND countdown shows once, in the band, not twice.
